notes: Voiceover scripts for the 14 s slide reels, written the way a real person talks to a friend: contractions, short sentences, natural pauses (... and ?). Recorded as ONE continuous take so it flows like a voice actor's read.
Keep each under ~32 words so it fits 14 s at a relaxed pace with the music dipped underneath.
Placeholders: {town}, {team} (town + mascot), {product} (e.g. 'heritage script crop hoodie'), {price} (e.g. 'And it's under fifty-five bucks!'), {cta}.
Rules from the 47 Swag Co playbook: no delivery-date promises, no live-preview language, no fake social proof or scarcity. Don't speak coupon codes (offers change; the last slide shows them).
CTA: on Facebook the product link is in the comments; on Instagram it's in the bio.

angles.why: Calls out the viewer's identity in the first second (local pride). Meta: put the brand and key message in the first 3 seconds.
angles.text: Okay {town}... this one's for you. Our new {product} just dropped. It's cropped, it's cozy, and it's perfect for game day. {price} {cta}

angles.why: Direct-question hook, one of the three hook types clothing-brand Reel guides recommend.
angles.text: Need a new game-day fit? Meet the {town} crop hoodie. Throw it on with your favorite jeans and you're good to go. {price} {cta}

angles.why: Speaks to the buyer (moms shopping for daughters), matching the MOMS offer on the last slide.
angles.text: Moms... she is going to live in this. The {town} crop hoodie. It's soft, it's cropped, and it's full of school pride. Grab her one! {cta}

angles.why: Announcement hook: the product and 'now available' land in the first 3 seconds.
angles.text: Just dropped for {town}! Our new {product} is finally here... and honestly? It goes with everything. {price} {cta}

angles.why: Problem/solution hook: names an everyday problem, then shows the fix.
angles.text: Nothing to wear? Fixed. The {town} crop hoodie goes with jeans, leggings... literally everything. {price} {cta}
